# Forensic counterexamples

All six files are generated locally, without copyrighted recordings. Regenerate with
`bash src-tauri/tests/fixtures/generate_forensic_corpus.sh /absolute/path/to/new-output`.
The script refuses to overwrite outputs and keeps its AAC intermediate in a printed temp
directory. Requires FFmpeg's native `aac` encoder, not macOS AudioToolbox. Codec versions
can change generated bytes; preserve these fixtures when comparing implementations.

| Fixture | Known history | Required outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `silence_96k.flac` | 12 seconds of exact stereo silence | No ultrasonic evidence; no LUFS/LRA; indeterminate |
| `native_96k_fir.flac` | Native 96 kHz noise, steep 18 kHz FIR, FLAC | Filter observed, never accused of a lossy history |
| `lossless_resampled_96k.flac` | Original corpus 44.1 kHz noise, sharp resampling filter, FLAC | Filter observed, indeterminate; no claimed original rate |
| `native_aac_256.flac` | Original dynamic stereo fixture → FFmpeg AAC 256 → FLAC | Confirmed KBD AAC grid; probably transcoded |
| `mp3_with_added_noise_96k.flac` | Original LAME V0 derivative → 96 kHz + seeded white noise → FLAC | Ultrasonic energy present but never called authentic; known abstention |
| `side_only_71.wav` | 48 kHz 7.1 PCM; only side L/R carry 1 kHz at -20 dBFS | LUFS ≈ -18.5, true peak ≈ -20; not silently ignored |

The source signals and FFmpeg filter arguments are fixed in the generation script.
Generated with FFmpeg Lavf 62.12.102 / Lavc 62.28.102. The 7.1 reference was checked with:

```sh
ffmpeg -i src-tauri/tests/fixtures/corpus/forensic/side_only_71.wav -af ebur128=peak=true -f null -
```

`tests/forensic_regressions.rs` mutates decoded buffers to check polarity, gain, cropping,
LFE-only content and an unknown layout. Those are not independent test-set examples.
Run `cargo test --workspace -- --nocapture` from `src-tauri/` for both this suite and the
original corpus's explicit miss/false-positive report. Research, limitations and the
before/after comparison live in [the detection note](../../../../../docs/detection-research.md).
